protocol.cv: leave-one-pair-out (21 folds), selection by micro-F1 M3 on the 20 training pairs

verdict: Cross-validated, the reranker moves the hybrid base from M1 0.718 / M3 0.641 to M1 0.718 / M3 0.641 (+0.000 / +0.000). That is still below both published systems (GraphMatcher 0.83 / 0.78, SORBETMtch 0.76 / 0.70); this is **not** a state-of-the-art claim. The change versus the base matcher is within the noise of a 21-pair test set.
